title: Labspace runtime
description: The Labspace interface, VS Code and a private Docker engine, inside a Docker Sandbox. Run it alone for the getting-started lab, or with a content kit.

title: Hello Labspace
description: A minimal lab: Run buttons that type into the IDE terminal, and an nginx container on the sandbox's own Docker engine, opened in a tab.

title: Building Container Images: Best Practices
description: Turn a basic Dockerfile into a production-grade image: layer caching, multi-stage builds, non-root users, Docker Hardened Images and build secrets.

title: Hardened Images Launch Lab
description: A lab from its own repository, built on these kits: the Labspace kit with the Docker Scout kit and the lab's content kit, also published as a single kit set.

title: Score Labspace
description: A lab from its own repository, built on these kits: the Labspace kit with the lab's content kit (score-compose, score-k8s and a Kind cluster), also published as a single kit set.

title: What's different from labspace-infra
description: From docker compose up to sbx run: what was removed, replaced and kept, and why a microVM with its own Docker engine needs far fewer moving parts.
